name: Akagi Kaori
source:
Kaori is [url=/c1501]Kouhei’s[/url] new older sister and she’s a very popular senpai at his school who appears to be good at everything. She’s very outgoing and has no problems talking to people and is quite protective and caring over her little sister [url=/c1497]Chisato[/url]. Kaori is also very kind and won’t hesitate to help a friend in need. Her dream is to become a doctor.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/08/12/relations-sister-x-sister-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
